name: v276_ebit_delivery_minus_active
hypothesis: EBIT delivery plus profitability was strong but crowded by an existing EBIT-delivery alpha; subtracting the EBIT mean/surprise carrier should leave a cleaner profitability/reversal residual.
field_notes: Local PnL grid from 0m7arnRv - 0.40*e7OVEPxp predicted Sharpe proxy about 1.99 and top ACTIVE corr about 0.48.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.208 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry) + 0.084 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value / assets, 126), industry) - 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.082 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.040 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.036 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
